start_here: Say to your AI: "Make my docs site files from this manifest." It runs tool:build-docs-site with the manifest and saves the files it returns.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing: the manifest comes in the request and the files come back in the answer.
instructions: 1. Give the site facts, navigation, pages, palettes and roles.
3. Read files: each { path, text } is one file of the docs site; problems lists anything that stopped the build.
